# `refresh.offer`

Legacy answer audit only. Weekly offers are retired by daily-cycle policy; this never fetches evidence.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice refresh-offer`
- **MCP tool:** `refresh_offer` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `integration` | `str` | required | slack, gmail or drive |
| `answer` | `str` | required | yes or no |

## Examples

```
operator-voice refresh-offer --integration slack --answer no
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
